post_title: Multipolar AI Models & LAM Rise as Sovereign AI Governance Emerges

sections.title: Sandia Neuromorphic PDE Simulation — First Real-World Proof of Energy-Efficient HPC
sections.lead: Research published in Nature Machine Intelligence shows that Sandia National Laboratories successfully performed physics simulations based on partial differential equations (PDEs) using brain-inspired hardware.

sections.title: DOE Genesis/SYNAPS-I — Real-Time Interpretation of Petabyte Science Data
sections.lead: The Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory-led consortium, with Argonne, Brookhaven, SLAC, and Oak Ridge, unveiled the ML pipeline Genesis/SYNAPS-I.

sections.title: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 & Kuaishou Kling 3.0 — Marginal Cost of Content Converges to Zero
sections.lead: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 combines a quad-modal architecture with multi-shot storyboarding and commercial-grade physical consistency, while Kuaishou Kling 3.0 advances video quality with 4K/15-second output and multilingual lip-sync.

sections.title: Alibaba Qwen 3.5 & Latam-GPT — AI Sovereignty Extends to Emerging Regions
sections.lead: Alibaba Qwen 3.5 is an open-weight model with enhanced math and coding reasoning competing directly with Meta Llama for developer mindshare, while Chile's CENIA-led Latam-GPT brings together institutions from 8 Latin American countries to develop Spa

sections.title: OpenAI Broad Expansion vs. Anthropic Differentiation
sections.lead: OpenAI concretized its enterprise AI OS strategy with ads, Frontier, and the Snowflake partnership, while Anthropic deepened its differentiation with a no-ads pledge, free-tier expansion, and PAC investment.

sections.title: Agentic AI / Large Action Models — Talk→Action Transition and Mandatory Governance
sections.lead: The Talk→Action transition is fully underway, and the concept of Large Action Models (LAM) combining Reasoning, Perception, and World Models has emerged.

sections.title: Canada-Germany Sovereign Technology Alliance & OPAQUE Data Lineage Tracking
sections.lead: Canada and Germany signed an AI joint declaration and launched the Sovereign Technology Alliance, presenting the first official model of AI governance cooperation among democratic nations.
